translation: O Agni, thou hast been ordained Hotar of every sacrifice, By Gods, among the race of men.
searchText: त्व मग्ने यज्ञाना होता विश्वेषा हितः देवेभि र्मानुषे जने o agni, thou hast been ordained hotar of every sacrifice, by gods, among the race of men.

translation: Agni we choose as envoy, skilled performer of this holy rite, Hotar, possessor of all wealth.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 3 agni we choose as envoy, skilled performer of this holy rite, hotar, possessor of all wealth.

translation: Served with oblation, kindled, bright, through love of song may Agni, bent On riches, smite the Vritras dead!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 4 served with oblation, kindled, bright, through love of song may agni, bent on riches, smite the vritras dead!

translation: I laud your most beloved guest like a dear friend, O Agni, him Who, like a chariot, wins us wealth.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 5 i laud your most beloved guest like a dear friend, o agni, him who, like a chariot, wins us wealth.

translation: Do thou, O Agni, with great might guard us from all malignity, Yea, from the hate of mortal man!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 6 do thou, o agni, with great might guard us from all malignity, yea, from the hate of mortal man!

translation: O Agni, come; far other songs of praise will I sing forth to thee. Wax mighty with these Soma-drops!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 7 o agni, come; far other songs of praise will i sing forth to thee. wax mighty with these soma-drops!

translation: May Vatsa draw thy mind away even from thy loftiest dwelling place! Agni, I yearn for thee with song.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 8 may vatsa draw thy mind away even from thy loftiest dwelling place! agni, i yearn for thee with song.

translation: Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the sky, the head Of all who offer sacrifice.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 9 agni, atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the sky, the head of all who offer sacrifice.

translation: O Agni, bring us radiant light to be our mighty succour, for Thou art our visible deity!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 10 o agni, bring us radiant light to be our mighty succour, for thou art our visible deity!

translation: O Agni, God, the people sing reverent praise to thee for strength: With terrors trouble thou the foe
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 11 o agni, god, the people sing reverent praise to thee for strength: with terrors trouble thou the foe

translation: I seek with song your messenger, oblation-bearer, lord of wealth, Immortal, best at sacrifice.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 12 i seek with song your messenger, oblation-bearer, lord of wealth, immortal, best at sacrifice.

translation: Still turning to their aim in thee the sacrificer's sister hymns Have come to thee before the wind.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 13 still turning to their aim in thee the sacrificer's sister hymns have come to thee before the wind.

translation: To thee, illuminer of night, O Agni, day by day with prayer, Bringing thee reverence, we come.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 14 to thee, illuminer of night, o agni, day by day with prayer, bringing thee reverence, we come.

translation: Help, thou who knowest lauds, this work, a lovely hymn in Rudra's praise, Adorable in every house!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 15 help, thou who knowest lauds, this work, a lovely hymn in rudra's praise, adorable in every house!

translation: To this fair sacrifice to drink the milky draught art thou called forth: O Agni, with the Maruts come!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 16 to this fair sacrifice to drink the milky draught art thou called forth: o agni, with the maruts come!

translation: With homage will I reverence thee, Agni, like a long-tailed steed, Imperial lord of holy rites.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 17 with homage will i reverence thee, agni, like a long-tailed steed, imperial lord of holy rites.

translation: As Aurva and as Bhrigu called, as Apnavana called, I call The radiant Agni robed with sea.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 18 as aurva and as bhrigu called, as apnavana called, i call the radiant agni robed with sea.

translation: When he enkindles Agni, man should with his heart attend the song: I kindle Agni till he glows.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 19 when he enkindles agni, man should with his heart attend the song: i kindle agni till he glows.

translation: Then, verily, they see the light refulgent of primeval seed, Kindled on yonder side of heaven.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 20 then, verily, they see the light refulgent of primeval seed, kindled on yonder side of heaven.

translation: Hither, for powerful kinship, I call Agni, him who prospers you, Most frequent at our solemn rites.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 21 hither, for powerful kinship, i call agni, him who prospers you, most frequent at our solemn rites.

translation: May Agni with his pointed blaze cast down each fierce devouring fiend: May Agni win us wealth by war!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 22 may agni with his pointed blaze cast down each fierce devouring fiend: may agni win us wealth by war!

translation: Agni, be gracious; thou art great: thou hast approached the pious man, Hast come to sit on sacred grass.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 23 agni, be gracious; thou art great: thou hast approached the pious man, hast come to sit on sacred grass.

translation: Agni, preserve us,from distress consume our enemies, O God, Eternal, with thy hottest flames
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 24 agni, preserve us,from distress consume our enemies, o god, eternal, with thy hottest flames

translation: Harness, O Agni, O thou God, thy steeds which are most excellent! The fleet ones bring thee rapidly.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 25 harness, o agni, o thou god, thy steeds which are most excellent! the fleet ones bring thee rapidly.

translation: Lord of the tribes, whom all must seek, we worshipped Agni set thee down, Refulgent, rich in valiant men.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 26 lord of the tribes, whom all must seek, we worshipped agni set thee down, refulgent, rich in valiant men.

translation: Agni is head and height of heaven, the master of the earth is he He quickeneth the waters' seed.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 27 agni is head and height of heaven, the master of the earth is he he quickeneth the waters' seed.

translation: O Agni, graciously announce this our good fortune of the Gods, And this our newest hymn of praise!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 28 o agni, graciously announce this our good fortune of the gods, and this our newest hymn of praise!

translation: By song, O Agni, Angiras! Gopavana hath brought thee forth Hear thou my call, refulgent one!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 29 by song, o agni, angiras! gopavana hath brought thee forth hear thou my call, refulgent one!

translation: Agni, the Sage, the Lord of Strength, hath moved around the sacred gifts, Giving the offerer precious things.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 30 agni, the sage, the lord of strength, hath moved around the sacred gifts, giving the offerer precious things.

translation: His heralds bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, The Sun, that all may look on him.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 31 his heralds bear him up aloft, the god who knoweth all that lives, the sun, that all may look on him.

translation: Praise Agni in the sacrifice, the Sage whose holy laws are true The God who driveth grief away.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 32 praise agni in the sacrifice, the sage whose holy laws are true the god who driveth grief away.

translation: Kind be the Goddesses to lend us help, and kind that we may drink: May their streams bring us health and wealth
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 33 kind be the goddesses to lend us help, and kind that we may drink: may their streams bring us health and wealth

translation: Lord of the brave, whose songs dost thou in thine abundance now inspire, Thou whose hymns help to win the kine?
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 34 lord of the brave, whose songs dost thou in thine abundance now inspire, thou whose hymns help to win the kine?

translation: Sing to your Agni with each song, at every sacrifice for strength. Come, let us praise the wise and, everlasting God even as a well-beloved friend,
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 35 sing to your agni with each song, at every sacrifice for strength. come, let us praise the wise and, everlasting god even as a well-beloved friend,

translation: Agni, protect thou us by one, protect us by the second song, Protect us by three hymns, O Lord of power and might, bright God, by four hymns guard us well!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 36 agni, protect thou us by one, protect us by the second song, protect us by three hymns, o lord of power and might, bright god, by four hymns guard us well!

translation: O Agni, with thy lofty beams, with thy pure brilliancy, O God, Kindled, most youthful one! by Bharadvaja's hand, shine on us richly, holy Lord!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 37 o agni, with thy lofty beams, with thy pure brilliancy, o god, kindled, most youthful one! by bharadvaja's hand, shine on us richly, holy lord!

translation: O Agni who art worshipped well, dear let our princes be to thee, Our wealthy patrons who are governors of men, who part, as gifts, the stall of kine!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 38 o agni who art worshipped well, dear let our princes be to thee, our wealthy patrons who are governors of men, who part, as gifts, the stall of kine!

translation: Agni, praise-singer! Lord of men, God! burning up the Rakshasas, Mighty art thou, the ever-present, household-lord! home-friend and guardian from the sky.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 39 agni, praise-singer! lord of men, god! burning up the rakshasas, mighty art thou, the ever-present, household-lord! home-friend and guardian from the sky.

translation: Immortal Jatavedas, thou bright-hued refulgent gift of Dawn, Agni, this day to him who pays oblations bring the Gods who waken with the morn!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 40 immortal jatavedas, thou bright-hued refulgent gift of dawn, agni, this day to him who pays oblations bring the gods who waken with the morn!

translation: Wonderful, with thy favouring help, send us thy bounties, gracious Lord. Thou art the charioteer, Agni, of earthly wealth: find rest and safety for our seed!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 41 wonderful, with thy favouring help, send us thy bounties, gracious lord. thou art the charioteer, agni, of earthly wealth: find rest and safety for our seed!

translation: Famed art thou, Agni, far and wide, preserver, righteous, and a Sage. The holy singers, O enkindled radiant one, ordainers, call on thee to come.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 42 famed art thou, agni, far and wide, preserver, righteous, and a sage. the holy singers, o enkindled radiant one, ordainers, call on thee to come.

translation: O holy Agni, give us wealth famed among men and strengthening life! Bestow on us, O helper, that which many crave, more glorious still through righteousness!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 43 o holy agni, give us wealth famed among men and strengthening life! bestow on us, o helper, that which many crave, more glorious still through righteousness!

translation: To him, who dealeth out all wealth, the sweet-toned Hotar-priest of men, To him like the first vessels filled with savoury juice, to Agni let the lauds go forth.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 44 to him, who dealeth out all wealth, the sweet-toned hotar-priest of men, to him like the first vessels filled with savoury juice, to agni let the lauds go forth.

translation: With this mine homage I invoke Agni for you, the Son of Strength, Dear, wisest envoy, skilled in noble sacrifice, immortal messenger of all.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 45 with this mine homage i invoke agni for you, the son of strength, dear, wisest envoy, skilled in noble sacrifice, immortal messenger of all.

translation: Thou liest in the logs that are thy mothers: mortals kindle thee. Alert thou bearest off the sacrifleer's gift, and then thou shinest to the Gods.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 46 thou liest in the logs that are thy mothers: mortals kindle thee. alert thou bearest off the sacrifleer's gift, and then thou shinest to the gods.

translation: He hath appeared, best prosperer, in whom men lay their holy acts: So may our songs of praise come nigh to Agni who was born to give the Arya strength!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 47 he hath appeared, best prosperer, in whom men lay their holy acts: so may our songs of praise come nigh to agni who was born to give the arya strength!

translation: Chief Priest is Agni at the laud, as stones and grass at sacrifice. Gods! Maruts! Brahmanaspati! I crave with song the help that is most excellent.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 48 chief priest is agni at the laud, as stones and grass at sacrifice. gods! maruts! brahmanaspati! i crave with song the help that is most excellent.

translation: Pray Agni of the piercing flame, with sacred songs, to be our help; For wealth, famed Agni, Purumilha and ye men! He is Suditi's sure defence.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 49 pray agni of the piercing flame, with sacred songs, to be our help; for wealth, famed agni, purumilha and ye men! he is suditi's sure defence.

translation: Hear, Agni who hast ears to hear, with all thy train of escort Gods! With those who come at dawn let Mitra, Aryaman sit on the grass at sacrifice.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 50 hear, agni who hast ears to hear, with all thy train of escort gods! with those who come at dawn let mitra, aryaman sit on the grass at sacrifice.

translation: Agni of Divodasa, God, comes forth like Indra in his might. Rapidly hath he moved along his mother earth: he stands in high heaven's dwelling-place.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 51 agni of divodasa, god, comes forth like indra in his might. rapidly hath he moved along his mother earth: he stands in high heaven's dwelling-place.

translation: Whether thou come from earth or from the lofty lucid realm of heaven, Wax stronger in thy body through my song of praise: fill full all creatures, O most wise!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 52 whether thou come from earth or from the lofty lucid realm of heaven, wax stronger in thy body through my song of praise: fill full all creatures, o most wise!

translation: If, loving well the forests, thou wentest to thy maternal floods, Not to be scorned, Agni, is that return of thine when, from afar, thou now art here.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 53 if, loving well the forests, thou wentest to thy maternal floods, not to be scorned, agni, is that return of thine when, from afar, thou now art here.

translation: O Agni, Manu stablished thee a light for all the race of men: With Kanva hast thou blazed, Law-born and waxen strong, thou whom the people reverence.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 54 o agni, manu stablished thee a light for all the race of men: with kanva hast thou blazed, law-born and waxen strong, thou whom the people reverence.

translation: The God who giveth wealth accept your full libation poured to, him! Pour ye it out, then fill the vessel full again, for so the God regardeth you.
accentedText: अग्न आ याहि वीतये गृणानो हव्यदातये। नि होता सत्सि बर्हिषि।।

translation: Let Brahmanaspati come forth, let Sunrita the Goddess come, And Gods bring to our rite which yields a fivefold gift the hero, lover of mankind!
searchText: त्व मग्ने यज्ञाना होता विश्वेषा हितः देवेभि र्मानुषे जने let brahmanaspati come forth, let sunrita the goddess come, and gods bring to our rite which yields a fivefold gift the hero, lover of mankind!

translation: Stand up erect to lend us aid, stand up like Savitar the God, Erect as strength-bestower when we call on thee with priests who balm our offerings!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 57 stand up erect to lend us aid, stand up like savitar the god, erect as strength-bestower when we call on thee with priests who balm our offerings!

translation: The man who bringeth gifts to thee, bright God who fain wouldst lead to wealth, Winneth himself a brave son, Agni! skilled in lauds, one prospering in a thousand ways.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 58 the man who bringeth gifts to thee, bright god who fain wouldst lead to wealth, winneth himself a brave son, agni! skilled in lauds, one prospering in a thousand ways.

translation: With hymns and holy eulogies we supplicate your Agni, Lord Of many families who duly serve the Gods, yea, him whom others too inflame.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 59 with hymns and holy eulogies we supplicate your agni, lord of many families who duly serve the gods, yea, him whom others too inflame.

translation: This Agni is the Lord of great prosperity and hero, strength, Of wealth with noble offspring and with store of kine, the Lord of battles with the foe.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 60 this agni is the lord of great prosperity and hero, strength, of wealth with noble offspring and with store of kine, the lord of battles with the foe.

translation: Thou, Agni, art the homestead's Lord, our Hotar-priest at sacrifice. Lord of all boons, thou art the Potar, passing wise. Pay worship, and enjoy the good!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 61 thou, agni, art the homestead's lord, our hotar-priest at sacrifice. lord of all boons, thou art the potar, passing wise. pay worship, and enjoy the good!

translation: We as thy friends have chosen thee, mortals a God, to be our help. The Waters' Child, the blessed, the most mighty one, swift conqueror, and without a peer.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 62 we as thy friends have chosen thee, mortals a god, to be our help. the waters' child, the blessed, the most mighty one, swift conqueror, and without a peer.

translation: Present oblations, make him splendid: set ye as Hotar in his place the Home's Lord, worshipped With gifts and homage where they pour libations! Honour him meet for reverence in our houses.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 63 present oblations, make him splendid: set ye as hotar in his place the home's lord, worshipped with gifts and homage where they pour libations! honour him meet for reverence in our houses.

translation: Verily wondrous is the tender youngling's growth who never draweth nigh to drink his mother's milk. As soon as she who hath no udder bore him, he, faring on his. great errand, suddenly grew strong.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 64 verily wondrous is the tender youngling's growth who never draweth nigh to drink his mother's milk. as soon as she who hath no udder bore him, he, faring on his. great errand, suddenly grew strong.

translation: Here is one light for thee, another yonder: enter the third and, be therewith united. Beautiful be thy union with the body, beloved in the Gods' sublimest birthplace!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 65 here is one light for thee, another yonder: enter the third and, be therewith united. beautiful be thy union with the body, beloved in the gods' sublimest birthplace!

translation: For Jatavedas, worthy of our praise, will we frame with our mind this eulogy as 'twere a car; For good, in his assembly, is this care of ours. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 66 for jatavedas, worthy of our praise, will we frame with our mind this eulogy as 'twere a car; for good, in his assembly, is this care of ours. let us not, in thy friendship, agni, suffer harm!

translation: Agni Vaisvanara, born in course of Order, the messenger of earth, the head of heaven, The Sage, the sovran, guest of men, our vessel fit for their mouth, the Gods have generated.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 67 agni vaisvanara, born in course of order, the messenger of earth, the head of heaven, the sage, the sovran, guest of men, our vessel fit for their mouth, the gods have generated.

translation: Even as the waters from the mountain ridges, so sprang the; Gods, through lauds, from thee, O Agni. To thee speed hymns and eulogies, as horses haste, bearing him who loves the song, to battle.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 68 even as the waters from the mountain ridges, so sprang the; gods, through lauds, from thee, o agni. to thee speed hymns and eulogies, as horses haste, bearing him who loves the song, to battle.

translation: Win to protect you, Rudra, lord of worship, priest of both worlds, effectual sacrificer, Agni, invested with his golden colours, before the thunder strike and lay you senseless!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 69 win to protect you, rudra, lord of worship, priest of both worlds, effectual sacrificer, agni, invested with his golden colours, before the thunder strike and lay you senseless!

translation: The King whose face is decked with oil is kindled with homage offered by his faithful servant. The men, the priests adore him with oblations. Agni hath shone forth at the flush of morning.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 70 the king whose face is decked with oil is kindled with homage offered by his faithful servant. the men, the priests adore him with oblations. agni hath shone forth at the flush of morning.

translation: Agni advanceth with his lofty banner: through earth and heaven the Bull hath loudly bellowed He hath come nigh from the sky's farthest limit: the Steer hath waxen in the waters' bosom.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 71 agni advanceth with his lofty banner: through earth and heaven the bull hath loudly bellowed he hath come nigh from the sky's farthest limit: the steer hath waxen in the waters' bosom.

translation: From the two fire-sticks have the men engendered with thoughts, urged by the hand, the glorious Agni, Far-seen, with pointed flame, Lord of the Homestead.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 72 from the two fire-sticks have the men engendered with thoughts, urged by the hand, the glorious agni, far-seen, with pointed flame, lord of the homestead.

translation: Agni is wakened by the people's fuel to meet the Dawn who cometh like a milch-cow. Like young trees shooting up on high their branches, his flames. are mounting to the vault of heaven.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 73 agni is wakened by the people's fuel to meet the dawn who cometh like a milch-cow. like young trees shooting up on high their branches, his flames. are mounting to the vault of heaven.

translation: Set forth the gleaming one, the song-inspirer, not foolish with. the foolish, fort- destroyer, Who leadeth with his hymns to thought of conquest, gold-bearded, richly splendid with his armour
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 74 set forth the gleaming one, the song-inspirer, not foolish with. the foolish, fort- destroyer, who leadeth with his hymns to thought of conquest, gold-bearded, richly splendid with his armour

translation: Thou art like heaven: one form is bright, one holy, like Day and Night dissimilar in colour. All magic powers thou aidest, self-dependent! Auspicious bethy bounty here, O Pushan!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 75 thou art like heaven: one form is bright, one holy, like day and night dissimilar in colour. all magic powers thou aidest, self-dependent! auspicious bethy bounty here, o pushan!

translation: As holy food, Agni, to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels! To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 76 as holy food, agni, to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels! to us be born a son and spreading offspring. agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward!

translation: Stablished to fill the juice with vital vigour, giver of wealth, guard of his servant's body, The great Priest, born, who knows the clouds, abider with men, is seated in the waters' eddy.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 77 stablished to fill the juice with vital vigour, giver of wealth, guard of his servant's body, the great priest, born, who knows the clouds, abider with men, is seated in the waters' eddy.

translation: Let the song, honouring the best, with longing honour the Asura's most famous sovran, The deeds of him the mighty, deeds like Indra's, the manly one in whom the folk must triumph!

translation: Bring us most mighty splendour thou, Agni, resistless on thy way: Prepare for us the path that leads to glorious opulence and strength!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 81 bring us most mighty splendour thou, agni, resistless on thy way: prepare for us the path that leads to glorious opulence and strength!

translation: May the brave man, if full of zeal he serve and kindle Agni's flame, Duly presenting sacred gifts, enjoy the Gods' protecting help.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 82 may the brave man, if full of zeal he serve and kindle agni's flame, duly presenting sacred gifts, enjoy the gods' protecting help.

translation: Thy bright smoke lifts itself aloft, and far-extended shines in heaven, For, Purifier! like the Sun thou beamest with thy radiant glow.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 83 thy bright smoke lifts itself aloft, and far-extended shines in heaven, for, purifier! like the sun thou beamest with thy radiant glow.

translation: Thou, Agni, even as Mitra, hast a princely glory of thine own. Bright, active God, thou makest fame increase like means of nourishment.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 84 thou, agni, even as mitra, hast a princely glory of thine own. bright, active god, thou makest fame increase like means of nourishment.

translation: At dawn let Agni, much-beloved, guest of the house, be glorified, In whom, the everlasting one, all mortals make their offerings blaze.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 85 at dawn let agni, much-beloved, guest of the house, be glorified, in whom, the everlasting one, all mortals make their offerings blaze.

translation: Most moving song be Agni's: shine on high, O rich in radiant light! Like the chief consort of a King riches and strength proceed from thee.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 86 most moving song be agni's: shine on high, o rich in radiant light! like the chief consort of a king riches and strength proceed from thee.

translation: Exerting all our strength with thoughts of power we glorify in speech Agni your dear familiar friend, the darling guest in every house.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 87 exerting all our strength with thoughts of power we glorify in speech agni your dear familiar friend, the darling guest in every house.

translation: His beam hath lofty power of life: sing praise to Agni, to the God Whom men have set in foremost place, like Mitra for their eulogy!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 88 his beam hath lofty power of life: sing praise to agni, to the god whom men have set in foremost place, like mitra for their eulogy!

translation: To noblest Agni, friend of man, chief Vritra-slayer, have we come- Who with Srutarvan, Riksha's son, in lofty presence is inflamed.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 89 to noblest agni, friend of man, chief vritra-slayer, have we come- who with srutarvan, riksha's son, in lofty presence is inflamed.

translation: Born as the loftiest Law commands, comrade of those who grew with him. Agni, the sire of Kasyapa by faith, the mother, Manu, Sage.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 90 born as the loftiest law commands, comrade of those who grew with him. agni, the sire of kasyapa by faith, the mother, manu, sage.

translation: We in King Soma place our trust, in Agni, and in Varuna, The Aditya, Vishnu, Surya, and the Brahman-priest Brihaspati.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 91 we in king soma place our trust, in agni, and in varuna, the aditya, vishnu, surya, and the brahman-priest brihaspati.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 92 hence have these men gone up on high and mounted to the heights of heaven: on! conquer on the path by which angirasas travelled to the skies!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 93 that thou mayst send us ample wealth, o agni, we will kindler thee: so, for the great oblation, steer, pray heaven and earth to come to us!

translation: He runs when one calls after him, This is the prayer of him who prays. He holds all knowledge in his grasp even as the felly rounds the wheel.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 94 he runs when one calls after him, this is the prayer of him who prays. he holds all knowledge in his grasp even as the felly rounds the wheel.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 95 shoot forth, o agni, with thy flame: demolish them on every side! break down the yatudhana's strength, the vigour of the rakshasa!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 96 worship the vasus, agni! here, the rudras and adityas, all who know fair sacrifices, sprung from mann, scattering blessings down!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 99 o agni, thou who art the lord of wealth in kine, thou son of strength, bestow on us, o jatavedas, high renown

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 100 most skilled in sacrifice, bring the gods, o agni, to the pious, man: a joyful priest, thy splendour drives our foes afar

translation: Taught by seven mothers at his birth was he, for glory of the wise. He, firm and sure, hath set his mind on glorious wealth
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 101 taught by seven mothers at his birth was he, for glory of the wise. he, firm and sure, hath set his mind on glorious wealth

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 102 and in the day our prayer is this: may aditi come nigh to help, with loving-kindness bring us weal and chase our foes

translation: Worship thou Jatavedas, pray to him who willingly accepts, Whose smoke wanders at will, and none may grasp his flame
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 103 worship thou jatavedas, pray to him who willingly accepts, whose smoke wanders at will, and none may grasp his flame

translation: No mortal man can e'er prevail by arts of magic over him Who hath served Agni well, the oblation-giving God.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 104 no mortal man can e'er prevail by arts of magic over him who hath served agni well, the oblation-giving god.

translation: Agni, drive thou the wicked foe, the evil-hearted thief away, Far, far, Lord of the brave! and give us easy paths!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 105 agni, drive thou the wicked foe, the evil-hearted thief away, far, far, lord of the brave! and give us easy paths!

translation: O hero Agni, Lord of men, on hearing this new laud of mine Burn down the Rakshasas, enchanters, with thy flame!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 106 o hero agni, lord of men, on hearing this new laud of mine burn down the rakshasas, enchanters, with thy flame!

translation: Sing forth to him the holy, most munificent, sublime with his refulgent glow, To Agni, ye Upastutas
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 107 sing forth to him the holy, most munificent, sublime with his refulgent glow, to agni, ye upastutas

translation: Agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of valiant sons and does great deeds, Whose bond of friendship is thy choice
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 108 agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of valiant sons and does great deeds, whose bond of friendship is thy choice

translation: Sing praise to him the Lord of light! The Gods have made the God to be their messenger, To bear oblation to the Gods.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 109 sing praise to him the lord of light! the gods have made the god to be their messenger, to bear oblation to the gods.

translation: Anger not him who is our guest! He is the bright God Agni, praised by many a man, God Hotar, skilled in sacrifice.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 110 anger not him who is our guest! he is the bright god agni, praised by many a man, god hotar, skilled in sacrifice.

translation: May Agni, worshipped, bring us bliss: may the gift, blessed one! and sacrifice bring bliss. Yea, may our eulogies bring bliss.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 111 may agni, worshipped, bring us bliss: may the gift, blessed one! and sacrifice bring bliss. yea, may our eulogies bring bliss.

translation: Thee have we chosen skilfullest in sacrifice, immortal Priest among the Gods, Wise finisher of this holy rite.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 112 thee have we chosen skilfullest in sacrifice, immortal priest among the gods, wise finisher of this holy rite.

translation: Bring us that splendour, Agni, which may overcome each greedy fiend in our abode, And the malicious wrath of men!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 113 bring us that splendour, agni, which may overcome each greedy fiend in our abode, and the malicious wrath of men!

translation: Soon as the eager Lord of men is friendly unto Manu's race Agni averteth from us all the Rakshasas!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 114 soon as the eager lord of men is friendly unto manu's race agni averteth from us all the rakshasas!

translation: Sing this, beside the flowing juice, to him your hero, much-invoked, To please him as a mighty Bull
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 115 sing this, beside the flowing juice, to him your hero, much-invoked, to please him as a mighty bull

translation: O Satakratu Indra, now rejoice with that carouse of thine Which is most glorious of all!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 116 o satakratu indra, now rejoice with that carouse of thine which is most glorious of all!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 117 ye cows, protect the fount: the two mighty ones bless the sacrifice. the handles twain are wrought of gold.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 118 sing praises that the horse may come; sing, srutakaksha, that the cow may come, that indra's might may come

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 119 we make this indra very strong to strike, the mighty vritra dead: a vigorous hero shall he be.

translation: Based upon strength and victory and power, O Indra, is thy birth: Thou, mighty one! art strong indeed,
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 120 based upon strength and victory and power, o indra, is thy birth: thou, mighty one! art strong indeed,

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 121 the sacrifice made indra great when he unrolled the earth, and made himself a diadem in heaven.

translation: If I, O Indra, were, like thee, the single ruler over wealth My worshipper should be rich in kine.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 122 if i, o indra, were, like thee, the single ruler over wealth my worshipper should be rich in kine.

translation: Pressers, blend Soma juice for him, each draught most excellent, for him The brave, the hero, for his joy.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 123 pressers, blend soma juice for him, each draught most excellent, for him the brave, the hero, for his joy.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 124 here is the soma juice expressed. o vasu, drink till thou art full: undaunted god, we give it thee

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 125 surya, thou mountest up to meet the hero famous for his wealth, who hurls the bolt and works for man.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 126 whatever, vritra-slayer! thou, surya hast risen upon to-day, that, indra, all is in thy power.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 127 that indra is our youthful friend, who with his trusty guidanceled turvasa, yadu from afar.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 128 o indra, let not ill designs surround us in the sunbeams' light this may we gain with thee for friend!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 129 indra, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor's ever-conquering wealth, most excellent, to be our aid

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 130 in mighty battle we invoke indra, indra is lesser fight, the friend who bends his bolt at fiends.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 131 in battle of a thousand arms indra drank kadru's soma juice there he displayed his manly might.

translation: Faithful to thee, we sing aloud, heroic Indra, songs to thee Mark, O good Lord, this act of ours!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 132 faithful to thee, we sing aloud, heroic indra, songs to thee mark, o good lord, this act of ours!

translation: Hitherward! they who light the flame and straightway trim the sacred grass, Whose friend is Indra ever young.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 133 hitherward! they who light the flame and straightway trim the sacred grass, whose friend is indra ever young.

translation: Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around, And bring the wealth for which we long!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 134 drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around, and bring the wealth for which we long!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 135 i hear, as though 'twere close at hand, the cracking of the whips they hold: they gather splendour on their way.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 136 indra, these friends of ours, supplied with soma, wait and look to thee as men with fodder to the herd.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 137 before his hot displeasure all the peoples, all the men bow down, as rivers bow them to the sea.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 138 we choose unto ourselves that high protection of the mighty gods, that it may help and succour us.

translation: O Brahmanaspati, make thou Kakshivan Ausija a loud Chanter of flowing Soma juice!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 139 o brahmanaspati, make thou kakshivan ausija a loud chanter of flowing soma juice!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 140 much honoured with libations may the vritra-slayer watch for us: may sakra listen to our prayer

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 141 send us this day, god savitar, prosperity with progeny drive thou the evil dream away!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 142 where is that ever-youthful steer, strong-necked and never yet bent down? what brahman ministers to him?

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 143 there where the mountains downward slope, there at the meeting of the streams the sage was manifest by song.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 144 praise indra whom our songs must laud, sole sovran of mankind, the chief most liberal who controlleth men

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 147 then straight they recognized the mystic name of the creative steer, there in the mansion of the moon.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 148 when indra, strongest hero, brought the streams, the mighty waters down, pushan was standing by his side.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 149 the cow, the streaming mother of the liberal maruts, pours her milk, harnessed to draw their chariots on.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 150 come, lord of rapturous joys, to our libation with thy bay steeds, come with bay steeds to the flowing juice

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 151 presented strengthening gifts have sent indra away at sacrifice, with night, unto the cleansing bath.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 152 i from my father have received deep knowledge of eternal law: i was born like unto the sun.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 153 with indra splendid feasts be ours, rich in all strengthening things, wherewith, wealthy in food, we may rejoice

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 154 soma and pushan, kind to him who travels to the gods, provide dwellings all happy and secure.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 155 invite ye indra with a song to drink your draught of soma steeds, juice, all-conquering satakratu, most munificent of all who live

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 156 sing ye a song, to make him glad, to indra, lord of tawny the soma-drinker, o my friends!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 157 this, even this, o indra, we implore: as thy devoted friends the kanvas praise thee with their hymns!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 158 for indra, lover of carouse, loud be our songs about the juice let poets sing the song of praise.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 159 here, indra, is thy soma draught, made pure upon the sacred grass: run hither, come and drink thereof

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 160 as a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of good deeds to our assistance duy by day.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 161 hero, the soma being shed, i pour the juice for thee to drink sate thee and finish thy carouse!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 162 the soma, indra, which is shed in saucers and in cups for thee, drink thou, for thou art lord thereof!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 163 in every need, in every fray we call, as friends, to succour us, indra, the mightiest of all.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 164 o come ye hither, sit ye down: to indra sing ye forth your song, companions, bringing hymns of praise

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 165 so, lord of affluent gifts, this juice hath been expressed for thee with strength: drink of it, thou who lovest song!

translation: Great is our Indra from of old; greatness be his, the Thunderer Wide as the heaven extends his might.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 166 great is our indra from of old; greatness be his, the thunderer wide as the heaven extends his might.

translation: Indra, as one with mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand Manifold and nutritious spoil!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 167 indra, as one with mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand manifold and nutritious spoil!

translation: Praise, even as he is known, with song Indra the guardian of the kine, The Son of Truth, Lord of the brave.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 168 praise, even as he is known, with song indra the guardian of the kine, the son of truth, lord of the brave.

translation: With what help will he come to us, wonderful, ever-waxing friend? With what most mighty company?
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 169 with what help will he come to us, wonderful, ever-waxing friend? with what most mighty company?

translation: Thou speedest down to succour us this ever-conquering God of yours Him who is drawn to all our songs.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 170 thou speedest down to succour us this ever-conquering god of yours him who is drawn to all our songs.

translation: To the assembly's wondrous Lord, the lovely friend of Indra, I Had prayed for wisdom and successs.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 171 to the assembly's wondrous lord, the lovely friend of indra, i had prayed for wisdom and successs.

translation: May all thy paths beneath the sky whereby thou speddest Vyasva on, Yea, let all spaces hear our voice
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 172 may all thy paths beneath the sky whereby thou speddest vyasva on, yea, let all spaces hear our voice

translation: Bring to us all things excellent, O Satakratu, food and strength, For, Indra, thou art kind to us!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 173 bring to us all things excellent, o satakratu, food and strength, for, indra, thou art kind to us!

translation: Here is the Soma ready pressed: of this the Maruts, yea, of this, Self-luminous the Asvins drink.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 174 here is the soma ready pressed: of this the maruts, yea, of this, self-luminous the asvins drink.

translation: Tossing about, the active ones came nigh to Indra at his birth, Winning themselves heroic might.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 175 tossing about, the active ones came nigh to indra at his birth, winning themselves heroic might.

translation: Never, O Gods, do we offend, nor are we ever obstinate We walk as holy texts command.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 176 never, o gods, do we offend, nor are we ever obstinate we walk as holy texts command.

translation: Evening is come: sing loudly thou Atharvan's nobly singing son: Give praise to Savitar the God!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 177 evening is come: sing loudly thou atharvan's nobly singing son: give praise to savitar the god!

translation: Now Morning with her earliest light shines forth, dear daughter of the Sky: High, Asvins, I extol your praise.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 178 now morning with her earliest light shines forth, dear daughter of the sky: high, asvins, i extol your praise.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 179 armed with the bones of dead dadhyach, indra, with unresisted might the nine-and-ninety vritras slew.

translation: Come, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all our Soma feasts, Protector, mighty in thy strength
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 180 come, indra, and delight thee with the juice at all our soma feasts, protector, mighty in thy strength

translation: O thou who slayest Vritras, come, O Indra, hither to our side, Mighty one, with thy mighty aids!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 181 o thou who slayest vritras, come, o indra, hither to our side, mighty one, with thy mighty aids!

translation: That might of his shone brightly forth when Indra brought together, like A skin, the worlds of heaven and earth,
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 182 that might of his shone brightly forth when indra brought together, like a skin, the worlds of heaven and earth,

translation: This is thine own Thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate: Thou carest, too, for this our prayer.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 183 this is thine own thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate: thou carest, too, for this our prayer.

translation: May Vata breathe his balm on us, healthful, delightful to our heart: May he prolong our days of life
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 184 may vata breathe his balm on us, healthful, delightful to our heart: may he prolong our days of life

translation: Ne'er is he injured whom the Gods Varuna, Mitra, Aryam. The excellently wise, protect.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 185 ne'er is he injured whom the gods varuna, mitra, aryam. the excellently wise, protect.

translation: According to our wish for kine, for steeds and chariots, as of old, Be gracious to our wealthy chiefs
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 186 according to our wish for kine, for steeds and chariots, as of old, be gracious to our wealthy chiefs

translation: Indra, these spotted cows yield thee their butter and the milky draught, Aiders, thereby, of sacrifice.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 187 indra, these spotted cows yield thee their butter and the milky draught, aiders, thereby, of sacrifice.

translation: That thou much-lauded! many-named! mayst, with this thought, that longs for milk, Come to each Soma sacrifice.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 188 that thou much-lauded! many-named! mayst, with this thought, that longs for milk, come to each soma sacrifice.

translation: May bright Sarasvati, endowed with plenteous wealth and spoil, enriched With prayer, desire the sacrifice.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 189 may bright sarasvati, endowed with plenteous wealth and spoil, enriched with prayer, desire the sacrifice.

translation: Why 'mid the Nahusha tribes shall sate this Indra with his Soma juice? He shall bring precious things to us.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 190 why 'mid the nahusha tribes shall sate this indra with his soma juice? he shall bring precious things to us.

translation: Come, we have pressed the juice for thee; O Indra, drink this Soma here: Sit thou on this my sacred grass
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 191 come, we have pressed the juice for thee; o indra, drink this soma here: sit thou on this my sacred grass

translation: Great, unassailable must be the heavenly favour of the Three, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 192 great, unassailable must be the heavenly favour of the three, varuna, mitra, aryaman.

translation: We, Indra, Lord of ample wealth, our guide, depend on one like thee, Thou driver of the tawny steeds!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 193 we, indra, lord of ample wealth, our guide, depend on one like thee, thou driver of the tawny steeds!

translation: Let Soma juices make thee glad! Display thy bounty, Thunderer: Drive off the enemies of prayer!
accentedText: अग्न आ याहि वीतये गृणानो हव्यदातये। नि होता सत्सि बर्हिषि।।

translation: Drink our libation, Lord of hymns! with streams of meath thou art bedewed: Yea, Indra, glory is thy gift.
searchText: त्व मग्ने यज्ञाना होता विश्वेषा हितः देवेभि र्मानुषे जने drink our libation, lord of hymns! with streams of meath thou art bedewed: yea, indra, glory is thy gift.

translation: Indra hath ever thought of you and tended you with care. The God, Heroic Indra, is not checked.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 196 indra hath ever thought of you and tended you with care. the god, heroic indra, is not checked.

translation: Let the drops pass within thee as the rivers flow into the sea O Indra, naught excelleth thee!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 197 let the drops pass within thee as the rivers flow into the sea o indra, naught excelleth thee!

translation: Indra, the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 198 indra, the singers with high praise, indra reciters with their lauds, indra the choirs have glorified.

translation: May Indra give, to aid us wealth handy that rules the skilful ones! Yea, may the Strong give potent wealth
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 199 may indra give, to aid us wealth handy that rules the skilful ones! yea, may the strong give potent wealth

translation: Verily Indra, conquering all, drives even mighty fear away, For firm is he and swift to act.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 200 verily indra, conquering all, drives even mighty fear away, for firm is he and swift to act.

translation: These songs with every draught we pour come, lover of the song, to thee As milch-kine hasten to their calves.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 201 these songs with every draught we pour come, lover of the song, to thee as milch-kine hasten to their calves.

translation: Indra and Wishan will we call for friendship and prosperity, And for the winning of the spoil.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 202 indra and wishan will we call for friendship and prosperity, and for the winning of the spoil.

translation: O Indra, Vritra-slayer, naught is better, mightier than thou Verily there is none like thee!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 203 o indra, vritra-slayer, naught is better, mightier than thou verily there is none like thee!

translation: Him have I magnified, our Lord in common, guardian of your folk, Discloser of great wealth in kine.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 204 him have i magnified, our lord in common, guardian of your folk, discloser of great wealth in kine.

translation: Songs have outpoured themselves to thee, Indra, the strong, the guardian Lord, And with one will have risen to thee!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 205 songs have outpoured themselves to thee, indra, the strong, the guardian lord, and with one will have risen to thee!

translation: Good guidance hath the mortal man whom Arya-man, the Marut host, And Mitras, void of guile, protect.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 206 good guidance hath the mortal man whom arya-man, the marut host, and mitras, void of guile, protect.

translation: Bring us the wealth for which we long, O Indra, that which is concealed In strong firm place precipitous.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 207 bring us the wealth for which we long, o indra, that which is concealed in strong firm place precipitous.

translation: Him your best Vritra-slayer, him the famous champion of mankind I urge to great munificence.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 208 him your best vritra-slayer, him the famous champion of mankind i urge to great munificence.

translation: Indra, may we adorn thy fame, fame of one like thee, hero! deck, Sakra! thy fame at highest feast!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 209 indra, may we adorn thy fame, fame of one like thee, hero! deck, sakra! thy fame at highest feast!

translation: Indra, accept at break of day our Soma mixt with roasted corn, With groats, with cake, with eulogies!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 210 indra, accept at break of day our soma mixt with roasted corn, with groats, with cake, with eulogies!

translation: With waters' foam thou torest off, Indra, the head of Namuchi, When thou o'ercamest all the foes.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 211 with waters' foam thou torest off, indra, the head of namuchi, when thou o'ercamest all the foes.

translation: Thine are these Soma juices, thine, Indra, those still to be expressed: Enjoy them, Lord of princely wealth!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 212 thine are these soma juices, thine, indra, those still to be expressed: enjoy them, lord of princely wealth!

translation: For thee, O Indra, Lord of light, Somas are pressed and grass is strewn: Be gracious to thy worshippers!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 213 for thee, o indra, lord of light, somas are pressed and grass is strewn: be gracious to thy worshippers!

translation: We seeking strength, with Soma drops fill full your Indra like a well, Most liberal, Lord of boundless might.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 214 we seeking strength, with soma drops fill full your indra like a well, most liberal, lord of boundless might.

translation: O Indra, even from that place come unto us with food that gives A hundred, yea, a thousand powers!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 215 o indra, even from that place come unto us with food that gives a hundred, yea, a thousand powers!

translation: The new-born Vritra-slayer asked his mother, as he seized his shaft, Who are the, fierce and famous ones?
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 216 the new-born vritra-slayer asked his mother, as he seized his shaft, who are the, fierce and famous ones?

translation: Let us call him to aid whose hands stretch far, the highly-lauded, who Fulfils the work to favour us
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 217 let us call him to aid whose hands stretch far, the highly-lauded, who fulfils the work to favour us

translation: Mitra who knoweth leadeth us, and Varuna who guideth straight, And Aryaman in accord with Gods.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 218 mitra who knoweth leadeth us, and varuna who guideth straight, and aryaman in accord with gods.

translation: When, even as she were present here, red Dawn hath shone from far away, She spreadeth light on every side.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 219 when, even as she were present here, red dawn hath shone from far away, she spreadeth light on every side.

translation: Varuna, Mitra, sapient pair, pour fatness on our pastures, pour Meath on the regions of the air!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 220 varuna, mitra, sapient pair, pour fatness on our pastures, pour meath on the regions of the air!

translation: And, at our sacrifices, these, sons, singers, have enlarged their bounds, So that the cows must walk knee-deep.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 221 and, at our sacrifices, these, sons, singers, have enlarged their bounds, so that the cows must walk knee-deep.

translation: Through all this world strode Vishnu: thrice his foot he planted, and the whole Was gathered in his footstep's dust.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 222 through all this world strode vishnu: thrice his foot he planted, and the whole was gathered in his footstep's dust.

translation: Pass by the wrathful offerer; speed the man who pours libation, drink The juice which he presents to thee!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 223 pass by the wrathful offerer; speed the man who pours libation, drink the juice which he presents to thee!

translation: What is the word addressed to him, God great and excellently wise? For this is what exalteth him.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 224 what is the word addressed to him, god great and excellently wise? for this is what exalteth him.

translation: His wealth who hath no store of kine hath ne'er found out recited laud, Nor song of praises that is sung.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 225 his wealth who hath no store of kine hath ne'er found out recited laud, nor song of praises that is sung.

translation: Lord of each thing that giveth strength, Indra delighteth most in lauds, Borne by bay steeds, libations' friend.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 226 lord of each thing that giveth strength, indra delighteth most in lauds, borne by bay steeds, libations' friend.

translation: With wealth to our libation come, be not thou angry with us, like A great man with a youthful bride.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 227 with wealth to our libation come, be not thou angry with us, like a great man with a youthful bride.

translation: When, Vasu, wilt thou love the laud? Now let the Channel bring the stream. The juice is ready to ferment.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 228 when, vasu, wilt thou love the laud? now let the channel bring the stream. the juice is ready to ferment.

translation: After the Seasons. Indra, drink the Soma from the Brahman's gift: Thy friendship is invincible! S. O Indra, lover of the song, we are the singers of thy praise O Soma-drinker, quicken us!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 229 after the seasons. indra, drink the soma from the brahman's gift: thy friendship is invincible! s. o indra, lover of the song, we are the singers of thy praise o soma-drinker, quicken us!

translation: O Indra, in each fight and fray give to our bodies manly strength: Strong Lord, grant ever-conquering might!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 230 o indra, in each fight and fray give to our bodies manly strength: strong lord, grant ever-conquering might!

translation: For so thou art the brave man's friend; a hero, too, art thou, and strong: So may thine heart be won to us!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 231 for so thou art the brave man's friend; a hero, too, art thou, and strong: so may thine heart be won to us!

translation: Like kine unmilked we call aloud, hero, to thee, and sing thy praise, Looker on heavenly light, Lord of this moving world, Lord, Indra, of what moveth not!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 232 like kine unmilked we call aloud, hero, to thee, and sing thy praise, looker on heavenly light, lord of this moving world, lord, indra, of what moveth not!

translation: That we may win us wealth and power we poets, verily, call on thee: In war men call on thee, Indra, the hero's Lord, in the steed's race-course call on thee:
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 233 that we may win us wealth and power we poets, verily, call on thee: in war men call on thee, indra, the hero's lord, in the steed's race-course call on thee:

translation: To you will I sing Indra's praise who gives good gifts as well we know; The praise of Maghavan who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousandfold.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 234 to you will i sing indra's praise who gives good gifts as well we know; the praise of maghavan who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousandfold.

translation: As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your wondrous God who checks attack, who takes delight in precious juice.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 235 as cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify this indra, even your wondrous god who checks attack, who takes delight in precious juice.

translation: Loud singing at the sacred rite where Soma flows we priests invoke With haste, that he may help, as the bard's cherisher, Indra who findeth wealth for you
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 236 loud singing at the sacred rite where soma flows we priests invoke with haste, that he may help, as the bard's cherisher, indra who findeth wealth for you

translation: With Plenty for his true ally the active man will gain the spoil. Your Indra, much-invoked, I bend with song, as bends a wright his wheel of solid wood.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 237 with plenty for his true ally the active man will gain the spoil. your indra, much-invoked, i bend with song, as bends a wright his wheel of solid wood.

translation: Drink, Indra, of the savoury juice, and cheer thee with our milky draught! Be, for our weal, our friend and sharer of the feast, and let thy wisdom guard us well!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 238 drink, indra, of the savoury juice, and cheer thee with our milky draught! be, for our weal, our friend and sharer of the feast, and let thy wisdom guard us well!

translation: For thou--come to the worshipper!--wilt find great wealth to make us rich. Fill thyself full, O Maghavan, for gain of kine, full, Indra, for the gain of steeds!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 239 for thou--come to the worshipper!--wilt find great wealth to make us rich. fill thyself full, o maghavan, for gain of kine, full, indra, for the gain of steeds!

translation: Vasishtha will not overlook the lowliest one among you all Beside our Soma juice effused to-day let all the Maruts drink with eager haste!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 240 vasishtha will not overlook the lowliest one among you all beside our soma juice effused to-day let all the maruts drink with eager haste!

translation: Glorify naught besides, O friends; so shall no sorrow trouble you! Praise only mighty Indra when the juice is shed, and say your lauds repeatedly!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 241 glorify naught besides, o friends; so shall no sorrow trouble you! praise only mighty indra when the juice is shed, and say your lauds repeatedly!

translation: A thousand and a hundred steeds are harnessed to thy golden car: Yoked by devotion, Indra, let the long-maned bays bring thee to drink the Soma juice!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 243 a thousand and a hundred steeds are harnessed to thy golden car: yoked by devotion, indra, let the long-maned bays bring thee to drink the soma juice!

translation: Come hither, Indra, with bay steeds, joyous, with tails like peacock's plumes! Let no men check thy course as fowlers stay the bird: pass o'er them as o'er desert lands!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 244 come hither, indra, with bay steeds, joyous, with tails like peacock's plumes! let no men check thy course as fowlers stay the bird: pass o'er them as o'er desert lands!

translation: Thou as a God, O mightiest, verily blessest mortal man. O Maghavan, there is no comforter but thou: Indra, I speak my words to thee.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 245 thou as a god, o mightiest, verily blessest mortal man. o maghavan, there is no comforter but thou: indra, i speak my words to thee.

translation: O Indra, thou art far-renowned, impetuous Lord of power and might. Alone, the never-conquered guardian of mankind, thou smitest down resistless foes.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 246 o indra, thou art far-renowned, impetuous lord of power and might. alone, the never-conquered guardian of mankind, thou smitest down resistless foes.

translation: Indra for worship of the Gods, Indra while sacrifice proceeds, Indra, as warriors in the battle-shock, we call, Indra that we may win the spoil.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 247 indra for worship of the gods, indra while sacrifice proceeds, indra, as warriors in the battle-shock, we call, indra that we may win the spoil.

translation: May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth! Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 248 may these my songs of praise exalt thee, lord, who hast abundant wealth! men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.

translation: These songs of ours exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise ascend to thee, Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength gain wealth and give unfailing help.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 249 these songs of ours exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise ascend to thee, like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength gain wealth and give unfailing help.

translation: Even as the wild-bull, when he thirsts, goes to the desert's watery pool, Come to us quickly both at morning and at eve, and with the Kanvas drink thy fill!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 250 even as the wild-bull, when he thirsts, goes to the desert's watery pool, come to us quickly both at morning and at eve, and with the kanvas drink thy fill!

translation: Indra, with all thy saving helps assist us, Lord of power and might! For after thee we follow even as glorious bliss, thee, hero, finderout of wealth.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 251 indra, with all thy saving helps assist us, lord of power and might! for after thee we follow even as glorious bliss, thee, hero, finderout of wealth.

translation: O Indra, Lord of light, what joys thou broughtest from the Asuras, Prosper therewith, O Maghavan, him who lauds that deed, and those whose grass is trimmed for thee!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 252 o indra, lord of light, what joys thou broughtest from the asuras, prosper therewith, o maghavan, him who lauds that deed, and those whose grass is trimmed for thee!

translation: To Aryaman and Mitra sing a reverent song, O pious one, A pleasant hymn to Varuna who shelters us: sing ye a laud unto the Kings!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 253 to aryaman and mitra sing a reverent song, o pious one, a pleasant hymn to varuna who shelters us: sing ye a laud unto the kings!

translation: Men with their lauds are urging thee, Indra, to drink the Soma first. The Ribhus in accord have lifted up their voice, and Rudras sung thee as the first.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 254 men with their lauds are urging thee, indra, to drink the soma first. the ribhus in accord have lifted up their voice, and rudras sung thee as the first.

translation: Sing to your lofty Indra, sing, Maruts, a holy hymn of praise Let Satakratu, Vritra-slayer, slay the foe with hundred-knotted thunderbolt!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 255 sing to your lofty indra, sing, maruts, a holy hymn of praise let satakratu, vritra-slayer, slay the foe with hundred-knotted thunderbolt!

translation: To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts! that slays the Vritras best, Whereby the holy ones created for the God the light divine that ever wakes.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 256 to indra sing the lofty hymn, maruts! that slays the vritras best, whereby the holy ones created for the god the light divine that ever wakes.

translation: O Indra, give us wisdom as a sire gives wisdom to his sons Guide us, O much-invoked, in this our way: may we still live and look upon the light!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 257 o indra, give us wisdom as a sire gives wisdom to his sons guide us, o much-invoked, in this our way: may we still live and look upon the light!

translation: O Indra, turn us not away: be present with us at our feast For thou art our protection, yea, thou art our kin: O Indra, turn us not away!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 258 o indra, turn us not away: be present with us at our feast for thou art our protection, yea, thou art our kin: o indra, turn us not away!

translation: We compass these like waters, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed. Here where the filter pours its stream, thy worshippers round thee, O Vritra-slayer, sit.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 259 we compass these like waters, we whose grass is trimmed and soma pressed. here where the filter pours its stream, thy worshippers round thee, o vritra-slayer, sit.

translation: All strength and valour that is found, Indra, in tribes of Nahushas, And all the splendid fame that the Five Tribes enjoy, bring, yea, all manly powers at once!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 260 all strength and valour that is found, indra, in tribes of nahushas, and all the splendid fame that the five tribes enjoy, bring, yea, all manly powers at once!

translation: Yea, verily thou art a Bull, our guardian, rushing like a bull: Thou, mighty one, art celebrated as a Bull, famed as a Bull both near and far.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 261 yea, verily thou art a bull, our guardian, rushing like a bull: thou, mighty one, art celebrated as a bull, famed as a bull both near and far.

translation: Whether, O Sakra, thou be far, or, Vritra-slayer, near at hand, Thence by heaven-reaching songs he who bath pressed the juice invites thee with thy long-maned steeds.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 262 whether, o sakra, thou be far, or, vritra-slayer, near at hand, thence by heaven-reaching songs he who bath pressed the juice invites thee with thy long-maned steeds.

translation: In the wild raptures of the juice sing to your hero with high laud, to him the wise, To Indra glorious in his name, the mighty one, even as the hymn alloweth it!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 263 in the wild raptures of the juice sing to your hero with high laud, to him the wise, to indra glorious in his name, the mighty one, even as the hymn alloweth it!

translation: O Indra, give us for our weal a triple refuge, triply strong! Bestow a dwelling-place on our rich lords and me, and keep thy dart afar from these!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 264 o indra, give us for our weal a triple refuge, triply strong! bestow a dwelling-place on our rich lords and me, and keep thy dart afar from these!

translation: Turning, as 'twere, to meet the Sun enjoy from Indra all good things! When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 265 turning, as 'twere, to meet the sun enjoy from indra all good things! when he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.

translation: The godless mortal gaineth not this food, O thou whose life is long! But one who yokes the bright-hued horses, Etasas; then Indra yokes his tawny steeds.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 266 the godless mortal gaineth not this food, o thou whose life is long! but one who yokes the bright-hued horses, etasas; then indra yokes his tawny steeds.

translation: Draw near unto our Indra who must be invoked in every fight! Come, thou most mighty Vritra-slayer, meet for praise, come to, libations and to hymns!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 267 draw near unto our indra who must be invoked in every fight! come, thou most mighty vritra-slayer, meet for praise, come to, libations and to hymns!

translation: Thine, Indra, is the lowest wealth, thou cherishest the midmost wealth, Thou ever rulest all the highest: in the fray for cattle none resisteth thee.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 268 thine, indra, is the lowest wealth, thou cherishest the midmost wealth, thou ever rulest all the highest: in the fray for cattle none resisteth thee.

translation: Where art thou? Whither art thou gone? For many a place attracts thy mind. Haste, warrior, fort-destroyer, Lord of battle's din! haste, holy songs have sounded forth!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 269 where art thou? whither art thou gone? for many a place attracts thy mind. haste, warrior, fort-destroyer, lord of battle's din! haste, holy songs have sounded forth!

translation: Here, verily, yesterday we let the thunder-wielder drink his fill. Bring him the juice poured forth in sacrifice to-day. Now range you by the glorious one!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 270 here, verily, yesterday we let the thunder-wielder drink his fill. bring him the juice poured forth in sacrifice to-day. now range you by the glorious one!

translation: He who as sovran Lord of men moves with his chariots unrestrained, The Vritra-slayer, vanquisher of fighting hosts, pre-eminent, is praised in song.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 271 he who as sovran lord of men moves with his chariots unrestrained, the vritra-slayer, vanquisher of fighting hosts, pre-eminent, is praised in song.

translation: Indra, give us security from that whereof we are afraid Help us, O Maghavan, let thy favour aid us thus; drive away foes and enemies!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 272 indra, give us security from that whereof we are afraid help us, o maghavan, let thy favour aid us thus; drive away foes and enemies!

translation: Strong pillar thou, Lord of the home! armour of Soma-offerers! The drop of Soma breaketh all the strongholds down, and Indra is the Rishis' friend.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 273 strong pillar thou, lord of the home! armour of soma-offerers! the drop of soma breaketh all the strongholds down, and indra is the rishis' friend.

translation: Verily, Surya, thou art great; truly, Aditya, thou art great! O most admired for greatness of thy majesty, God, by thy greatness thou art great!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 274 verily, surya, thou art great; truly, aditya, thou art great! o most admired for greatness of thy majesty, god, by thy greatness thou art great!

translation: Indra! thy friend, when fair of form and rich in chariots, steeds, and kine, Hath ever vital power that gives him strength, and joins the company with radiant men.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 275 indra! thy friend, when fair of form and rich in chariots, steeds, and kine, hath ever vital power that gives him strength, and joins the company with radiant men.

translation: O Indra, if a hundred heavens and if a hundred earths were thine,-- No, not a hundred suns could match thee at thy birth, not both the worlds, O Thunderer!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 276 o indra, if a hundred heavens and if a hundred earths were thine,-- no, not a hundred suns could match thee at thy birth, not both the worlds, o thunderer!

translation: Though, Indra, thou art called by men eastward and west ward, north and south, Thou chiefly art with Anava and Turvasa, brave champion urged by men to come.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 277 though, indra, thou art called by men eastward and west ward, north and south, thou chiefly art with anava and turvasa, brave champion urged by men to come.

translation: Indra whose wealth is in thyself, what mortal will attack this man? The strong will win the spoil on the decisive day through faith in thee, O Maghavan!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 278 indra whose wealth is in thyself, what mortal will attack this man? the strong will win the spoil on the decisive day through faith in thee, o maghavan!

translation: First, Indra! Agni! hath this Maid come footless unto those with feet. Stretching her head and speaking loudly with her tongue, she hath gone downward thirty steps.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 279 first, indra! agni! hath this maid come footless unto those with feet. stretching her head and speaking loudly with her tongue, she hath gone downward thirty steps.

translation: Come, Indra, very near to us with aids of firmly-based resolve Come, most auspicious, with thy most auspicious help; good kinsman, with good kinsmen come!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 280 come, indra, very near to us with aids of firmly-based resolve come, most auspicious, with thy most auspicious help; good kinsman, with good kinsmen come!

translation: Call to your aid the eternal one who shoots and none may shoot at him, Inciter, swift, victorious, best of charioteers, unconquered, Tugriya's strengthener!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 281 call to your aid the eternal one who shoots and none may shoot at him, inciter, swift, victorious, best of charioteers, unconquered, tugriya's strengthener!

translation: Let none, no, not thy worshippers, delay thee far away from us Even from faraway come thou unto our feast, or listen if' already here!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 282 let none, no, not thy worshippers, delay thee far away from us even from faraway come thou unto our feast, or listen if' already here!

translation: For Indra Soma-drinker, armed with thunder, press the Soma juice; Make ready your dressed meats: cause him to favour us! The giver blesses him who gives.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 283 for indra soma-drinker, armed with thunder, press the soma juice; make ready your dressed meats: cause him to favour us! the giver blesses him who gives.

translation: We call upon that Indra who, most active, ever slays the foe With boundless spirit, Lord of heroes, manliest one, help thou and prosper us in fight!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 284 we call upon that indra who, most active, ever slays the foe with boundless spirit, lord of heroes, manliest one, help thou and prosper us in fight!

translation: Ye rich in strength, through your great power vouchsafe us blessings day and night! The offerings which we bring to you shall never fail gifts brought by us shall never fail.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 285 ye rich in strength, through your great power vouchsafe us blessings day and night! the offerings which we bring to you shall never fail gifts brought by us shall never fail.

translation: Whenever mortal worshipper will sing a bounteous giver's praise, Let him with song inspired laud Varuna who supports the folk who follow varied rites.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 286 whenever mortal worshipper will sing a bounteous giver's praise, let him with song inspired laud varuna who supports the folk who follow varied rites.

translation: Drink milk to Indra in the joy of Soma juice, Medhyatithi! To golden Indra ever close to his bay steeds, the thunder-armed, the golden one!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 287 drink milk to indra in the joy of soma juice, medhyatithi! to golden indra ever close to his bay steeds, the thunder-armed, the golden one!

translation: Both boons,-may Indra, hitherward turned listen to this prayer of ours, And mightiest Maghavar, with thought inclined to us come near to drink the Soma juice!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 288 both boons,-may indra, hitherward turned listen to this prayer of ours, and mightiest maghavar, with thought inclined to us come near to drink the soma juice!

translation: Not for an ample price dost thou, Stone-caster! give thyself away, Not for a thousand, Thunderer! nor ten thousand, nor a hundred, Lord of countless wealth!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 289 not for an ample price dost thou, stone-caster! give thyself away, not for a thousand, thunderer! nor ten thousand, nor a hundred, lord of countless wealth!

translation: O Indra, thou art more to me than sire or niggard brother is. Thou and my mother, O good Lord, appear alike, to give me wealth abundantly.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 290 o indra, thou art more to me than sire or niggard brother is. thou and my mother, o good lord, appear alike, to give me wealth abundantly.

translation: I call on thee, Sabardugha, this day, inspirer of the psalm. Indra, the richly-yielding milch-cow who provides unfailing food in ample stream.
